craft_notes: Sthāyin: strengthening — breath by offering. Rows: breath then strengthening. Read aloud: deep breath.

lines: In breath — stated, pervaded, world-made — strengthened by gifts of cup and food, scent and smoke, through the taught knowing-pervasion: this is breath-rite.
l4.sanskrit_cite: uktavyāptike prāṇe viśvamaye proktasaṃvidvyāptyā tarpaṇānnagandhadhūpādisamarpaṇena upodbalanaṃ prāṇayāgaḥ
